summary: Head-and-shoulders bottom measured move: the vertical distance from the head low to the neckline (measured at the head) is added to the neckline breakout price to get the first-wave target, and added again for the second (and third) wave. Long entry on the neckline breakout (stop 5-7% / falling back below the neckline); when a 破底翻 forms at the head or right shoulder it gives an earlier, lower entry and the breakout becomes an add-on. Four Taiwan daily cases (东元 1999-2000, 蓝天 2008-09, 扬明光 2010, 广宇 2011-12) show the arithmetic, multi-wave targets, false-breakout exits, and the base-size vs. move-duration judgement for whether to expect a second wave.

patterns.name_en: Head-and-shoulders bottom (inverse H&S) with measured-move target
patterns.structure: Left shoulder, lower head, right shoulder, with a neckline joining the reaction highs; the neckline may slope (schematic neckline labels 80 → 78 → 76 → 74, and 东元/蓝天/广宇 slope down) or be horizontal (扬明光 142.1, '颈线为平行线'). Schematic: head low 60, neckline above the head at 78, breakout of the (down-sloping) neckline at 74. The head is often itself a 破底翻 (break below the left-shoulder lows then reclaim), as in 东元 2/22, 扬明光 11/15, 广宇 12/23.
patterns.entry: Buy when price breaks above the neckline (突破颈线时多单进场; schematic buy ~75 after break at 74). Breakout is treated as confirmed when price clears the nearby prior high on the neckline (蓝天 buy 20.4 when above 20.34; 广宇 buy 24.7 when above 24.63). If a 破底翻 forms at the head, buy that first and add on the neckline breakout (多单加码).
patterns.stop: 5%-7%, which is also the point of falling back below the neckline (停损设5%～7%，也是跌破颈线时). Cases use the breakout-day long-red low (蓝天 19.26, 5.6%), prior-day close (广宇 24.14, 4%), or a level just below the neckline (东元 14.1, 3.4%; 扬明光 137, 4%). For a 破底翻 entry, stop at the support/re-break level rather than the extreme low if the extreme low is >10% away (东元: 10.2 instead of 9.34; 扬明光 127; 广宇 21.5).

target.formula: distance = neckline_at_head - head_low; target_1 = neckline_breakout_price + distance; target_n = target_(n-1) + distance

confirmation: Breakout with volume (带量突破/带量跳空/带量长红): 东元 1/5 gap with volume, 蓝天 12/19 volume breakout, 广宇 1/30 volume gap long red.
Clearing the most recent prior high near the neckline confirms the breakout (蓝天 20.34, 广宇 24.63).
A 破底翻 at the head confirms the bottom early (东元 2/22, 扬明光 11/15, 广宇 12/23).
invalidation: Falling back below the neckline after the breakout (跌破颈线 / 跌落线下) — stop on the add-on position.
A false breakout (假突破) near the target is the sell signal (蓝天 8/4, 扬明光 12/27, 广宇).

rules.rule: Measured move: the distance from the head low to the neckline equals the distance projected above the neckline breakout.
rules.quote_zh: 低点到颈线的距离＝突破颈线后的距离。

rules.rule: Schematic arithmetic: head low 60 to neckline 78 = 18; breakout 74 + 18 = 92 first target; 92 + 18 = 110 second target.
rules.quote_zh: 突破颈线的位置74+18＝等幅计算的涨幅满足92。

rules.rule: Enter long on the neckline breakout (e.g. buy ~75), stop 5%-7% which coincides with falling back below the neckline; if the neckline holds, take profit at the first or second wave target (~22%-46%).
rules.quote_zh: 突破颈线时多单进场，如买在75附近停损设5%～7%，也是跌破颈线时，颈线不破，达一至两波涨幅满足时，多单获利了结，约22%～46%。

rules.rule: If the 破底翻 low gives a stop more than 10% away, the risk is too high; place the stop at the re-break of the line instead (东元 10.2, risk 6.5%).
rules.quote_zh: 停损若设9.34元低点，风险超过10%太高，可设在10.2元附近，也就是再度破线确立时，风险6.5%。

rules.rule: Base size vs. move duration: a base lasting over 1.5 years that reaches the first target after only half a month of rally should be expected to continue to the second-wave target.
rules.quote_zh: 以东元长达逾一年半以上的底部规模仅涨半个多月，便达首波涨幅满足，因此，可续看第二波涨幅满足。

rules.rule: Breakout is confirmed when price clears the nearby prior high of the pre-breakout range; stop at the breakout day's volume long-red low (falling back below the line).
rules.quote_zh: 约可买在20.4元附近（突破关前整理区的近期高点20.34元，确定突破时），停损设当日带量长红低点19.26元，也是跌落线下时，风险约5.6%。

rules.rule: Usually take profit at the two-wave target; if the move extends to the third wave, the false breakout is the confirmed sell signal.
rules.quote_zh: 通常达两波段涨幅满足，便获利了结约68%，若达第三波涨幅满足后，2009年8月4日出现假突破，确定卖出信号，获利了结约96%。

rules.rule: A new high followed within a few days by falling back below the line confirms a false breakout and that the stock only rises one wave; the topping structure is comparable in size to the base.
rules.quote_zh: 12月22日长红突破再创新高后第三个交易日12月27日，便跌落线下，假突破确立，也确立扬明光技术面只涨一波，盘头的规模与盘底的规模相当。

rules.rule: If after the first target the high-level consolidation lasts long (comparable to the base) and then a false breakout occurs, expect only one wave.
rules.quote_zh: 高档震荡续创新高后，立即回跌出现假突破，且破线后整理的时间过长与底部的规模相当，因此只看一波。

rules.rule: Stage the position: buy at the 破底翻 (lower, wider profit) and add on the neckline breakout (tighter stop); the 破底翻 position earns the larger percentage.
rules.quote_zh: 多单获利了结约19%（加码多单）～30%（破底翻多单）。

rules.rule: Without a second wave, exit both positions on the false breakout / fall below the line after the target.
rules.quote_zh: 达涨幅满足附近后的12月27日跌落线下，假突破确立，无第二波行情时，多单获利了结约17%（加码多单）～25%（破底翻多单）。

rules.rule: Risk control first: accept losses and never let them get out of control (Marty Schwartz quote).
rules.quote_zh: 我更关心的是，怎么控制失利状况。要学会接受亏损。想赚钱，最重要的就是不能让亏损失控。

rules.rule: Have the courage to admit mistakes and correct them immediately (George Soros quote).
rules.quote_zh: 我有认错的勇气。当我一发现犯错，马上改正，这对我的事业十分有帮助。

worked_examples.pattern: 头肩底 + 破底翻底部
worked_examples.outcome: 破底翻 1999-02-22; 2000-01-05 volume gap breakout of neckline; hit both targets (high 26.13) then pulled back sharply; profit ~78% (add-on) to ~140% (破底翻 entry)

worked_examples.pattern: 头肩底 → 三波涨幅满足 → 假突破
worked_examples.outcome: 2008-12-19 volume breakout; target 1 hit with brief 2-day pullback; 2nd wave then wide range; 3rd target then 2009-08-04 false breakout sell; profit ~68% at two waves, ~96% at the false breakout

worked_examples.pattern: 破底翻 + 头肩底 (horizontal neckline) → 假突破
worked_examples.outcome: 破底 2010-11-03, 破底翻 11-15, neckline breakout 12-03; target hit in 3 days; new high 12-22 then 12-27 fell below line = false breakout, only one wave; profit ~17% (add-on) to ~25% (破底翻)

worked_examples.pattern: 破底翻 + 头肩底 → 假突破
worked_examples.outcome: 破底翻 2011-12-23 (broke above long-black high); 2012-01-30 volume gap long red neckline breakout; high 32.26 then false breakout, only one wave; profit ~19% (add-on) to ~30% (破底翻)

quantifiable: Detect inverse H&S: three troughs with middle lowest; neckline = line through the two reaction highs between them (may slope).
distance = neckline_value_at_head_bar - head_low; target_k = breakout_price + k * distance for k = 1, 2, 3.
Entry: close above the neckline AND above the nearest prior swing high on the neckline; stop = max(entry*(1-0.07), breakout-bar low) and/or close back below neckline.
Early entry: 破底翻 at the head (new low below left-shoulder range then close back above it); stop at the reclaimed level if (entry - head_low)/entry > 10%.

Expect a second wave if target_1 was reached in much less time than the base duration (东元: base >1.5 yr, rally ~0.5 month); expect only one wave if post-target consolidation lasts about as long as the base and ends with a false breakout.
Exit: false breakout = new high above target zone followed within ~3 bars by close back below the breakout line.
ambiguities: Breakout price used for the projection is approximate (约) and differs from the neckline-at-head value on sloping necklines (东元 14.2 vs 15.3; 蓝天 20 vs 20.8; 广宇 24.5 vs 25.2); the book does not define it precisely (break bar close? intersection price?).
Stop rule mixes a percentage (5-7%) with a structural level (below neckline / breakout bar low / prior close); which takes precedence is not stated.
'Base size' vs. 'move duration' judgement (R5, R9) is qualitative; no numeric ratio given.
Third-wave target (蓝天 41.63) is presented without saying when a third wave should be expected beyond 'after second-wave consolidation'.
